title: Giants, Dexter Lawrence reach impasse on contract extension talks; NY to continue search for trade partner: report

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Giants, Dexter Lawrence reach impasse on contract extension talks; NY to continue search for trade partner: report
sources.description: The Giants and star Dexter Lawrence have reportedly reached an impasse on a contract extension and the team continues to search for a trade partner for the defensive tackle.
